entities.summary: Riccardo Adami is an Italian engineer working for Scuderia Ferrari. He is currently the manager of the Ferrari Driver Academy and Ferrari's Testing of Previous Cars program and the former race engineer of Sebastian Vettel, Carlos Sainz Jr. and Lewis Hamilton.
